card.name: Sulfonamide sensitization recurrence wording
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "a" (or "is") in the sulfonamide warning "Sensitization may recur when a sulfonamide is readministered". Also a few spots inside drug-class names, like carbonic anhydrase inhibitors or other ibuprofen products.

modes.label: Sulfonamide re-exposure warning
modes.description: The word "a" or "is" around "sulfonamide is readministered" in sensitization warnings.
modes.example: Sensitizations may recur when<< a>> sulfonamide is readministered

modes.label: Inside drug-class names
modes.description: Partway through a drug-class or drug name in a warning about combining similar drugs.
modes.example: oral carbon<<ic>> anhydrase inhibitors is not recommended.

card.writes: Promotes words meaning same or similar, such as identical, which fits a repeat exposure to a similar drug.
card.plain: It marks warnings about giving the same or a similar drug again, especially the sulfonamide sensitization line.
